item.content:encoded:
News / TradingView / Key facts: Eli Lilly posts $23B quarter; Foundayo approved, $50 copay

Key facts: Eli Lilly posts $23B quarter; Foundayo approved, $50 copay Less than 1 min read

LLY Eli Lilly (LLY) posted $23.0B quarterly revenue, up 48% year-over-year. Volumes rose 60% while realized prices fell 13%. Mounjaro and Zepbound drove about $14.9B of sales. GuruFocus Eli Lilly (LLY) won April 2026 approval for Foundayo, its oral GLP‑1 therapy, marking market authorization for the company’s oral GLP‑1 product. Benzinga Medicare’s 2025 policy sets a $50 copay for approved injectable and oral GLP-1s. Eli Lilly’s oral GLP-1 Foundayo is included among drugs subject to the $50 copay. Benzinga Eli Lilly (LLY) reported Phase 1 ESMO 2026 data for its FRα-targeting ADC in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer: objective response rate 79%, disease control rate 100%. Reuters Eli Lilly (LLY) GLP‑1 drug Mounjaro linked to higher consumer demand for high‑protein foods; surveys show users plan about 11% higher spending to offset potential GLP‑1–related muscle loss Reuters Eli Lilly (LLY) shares fell about 1.7% in premarket trading ahead of its earnings release as traders positioned for results and pricing impact on profit.
